format: FIDBIN01 binary snapshot container inside standard gzip and wide raw120 transport
purpose: Remove embedded base64 compression overhead without changing any decoded fields or asset bytes
layout: 8-byte versioned magic; little-endian uint32 header UTF8 byte length; header bytes; uint32 asset count; each asset uint32 data-URI-prefix byte length, UTF8 prefix, uint32 binary byte length and original decoded bytes. Header reserved placeholder literals expand back to exact canonical JSON data URI strings; identical full literals deduplicated.
validationRules: All byte-length reads and slices bounds checked
Asset count bounded by remaining container bytes
Strict UTF8 and data URI prefix validation
Exact canonical index and reference bounds
compatibility: Full HTML snapshot only changes compressed inner representation. Readable snapshot.json and generated legacy radix85 snapshot-packed.js keep original gzip JSON transport. Decoder accepts ordinary gzip JSON and FIDBIN01; wide/raw120v1/radix85/base64 compatibility retained. App gzip raw120v1 Blob import/revoke and unsupported-browser message unchanged.

validation.normalOfflineGanymede: own globe and three images passed
validation.engine: Chrome; other engines remain independently untested

limits: No50th dossier or new embedded Callisto asset. All prior original PNG/master/native science/model/shape/map files untouched. Callisto display rendition retained and inspected for subsequent integration; original remains preserved.
